This was a fun read. +1

The two booksellers could have passed for any number of normal people, being of intermittent builds and dressed in slightly-ragged parkas, if only they not been wearing wooden masks carved in the likeness of sheep heads.

I'm not sure if I'm reading this wrong, but I think this should be:

The two booksellers could have passed for any number of normal people, being of intermittent builds and dressed in slightly-ragged parkas, if only they had not been wearing wooden masks carved in the likeness of sheep heads.

item.content:encoded:
I missed the boat on critiquing this one (thanks for messaging me!) but I wouldn't have had anything to add - this was already brilliant as a draft, and is even better woth the tweaks you made.

I continue to be completely in love with the cynicism and casual violence of how this O5 does business, and how Egret's coolness is perfectly tempered by the details that show how awful she is inside. This series has been a great time so far, and i can't wait to see where it goes.
